areas.label: Locomotive Cab
areas.desc: Engine (ST 01). The driver and stoker work here; the boiler the signal-wright rigged to overpressure is vented from this cab. This is the front objective of the split-the-party clock: vent it or it ruptures. Open-top, with the cowcatcher and footplate exposed at the nose.

areas.label: Coal Tender
areas.desc: Cargo Coal (ST 28). The open coal hopper between engine and cars. A kinetic exterior position with no cover but the coal pile; the natural place to climb up onto the roofs.

areas.label: Strongbox Car
areas.desc: Military Transport (ST 24). The armoured car: a locked strongroom holds the featured crate, and the twitchy Eisenhart factor guards his manifest at the central strategy table, weapon racks to the walls. The signal-wright converges here for the crate. The climax room and the marquee loot.

areas.label: Passenger Car
areas.desc: Steerage (ST 14). Where the party starts the ride, on the benches among the civilians. The planted accomplice turns here; bystanders to protect. 44 seats in two cushioned rows down a central aisle.

areas.label: Gun Flat
areas.desc: Cannons (ST 23). An open car of mounted Eisenhart cannons in transit; the mounts are both cover and hazard. A moderate exterior fight, exposed to the roofs above.

areas.label: Brakeman's Van
areas.desc: Crew Quarters (ST 03). The rear car: hammocks, a galley, storage, and the brake-wheel that matters. Where the rear boarders force their entry.
